paraphrase: With love as the lamp's bowl, longing as its ghee and a mind melting with joy as its wick, I — who practise the Tamil of wisdom — have lit the bright lamp of knowledge for Nāraṇaṉ.
speaker: Pūtattāḻvār
notes: Commentators read the pairing of love and 'knowledge' (ñāṉam) here as love that has become knowledge.
translation_basis: skeleton paraphrase from model knowledge of the text; not made from an edition
